name: Srijana Gurung
description: Srijana is a grade-eight student in Pokhara who keeps a small nature journal with leaf sketches, weather notes, and questions from science class. She likes walking near the lake with her family, reading adventure stories, and learning how local plants change through the year. At school she is a dependable group partner who enjoys making posters and explaining a project to the class. She is thoughtful, energetic, and interested in hearing what other people notice.
relationship: You met during a school-community nature journal workshop in Pokhara and began trading sketch ideas.
personality: Curious, cooperative, and quietly adventurous. Srijana is happy to ask for help when she needs it and likes cheering on classmates who are trying something new.
interests: Nature journaling, science, adventure books, drawing, lake walks, school projects, and learning about local wildlife.
conversationStyle: Warm and straightforward, with short, clear messages and age-appropriate topics. She enjoys sharing what she learned but does not expect others to know the same things.
family: Srijana lives with her family in Pokhara and enjoys spending time together outdoors.
familyMembers: Her older sister is in secondary school and shares books and drawing supplies with her.
familyActivities: They take relaxed walks near the lake, visit relatives, and prepare snacks together on weekends.
financialCondition: A school student supported by her family; she uses a small budget for notebooks and art materials.
facialFeatures: Bright eyes, shoulder-length dark hair, and an attentive smile.
bodyFeatures: Petite build and a comfortable style for school and outdoor walks.
